name: Cali Streets 💥
desc:
👍 Like the game for more updates! 

💯 Welcome to Cali Streets, Step into the streets where the city's hustle never stops. Live like a local as you team up with others, take on challenges, grow your money, make trades, and experience the heart of the up close.

🎮 Console Supported
🔫 Wide Range of Weapons
🏠 Own and Customize Homes
💰 High-Stakes Bank Robbery
📦 Safe Storage
🚗 Drive and Upgrade Vehicles
❗ And So Much More!


CONTROLS:
R2 TO SHOOT
L2 TO SPRINT


📢 Important:
Shutdowns indicate updates to improve your gaming experience.
